description: Search the IQ.net catalogue when the user wants an API, MCP server, agent tool, advertised x402 price, or curated GitHub project. Covers the MCP Registry, the Coinbase x402 Bazaar, Apify Actors, curated GitHub repositories, and reviewed provider submissions. A numeric price filter needs both currency and billing_unit. Pass mcp as the string true for MCP Registry servers, x402 as the string true for an advertised x402 price, mcp_mode as remote or local, source as apify or github, open_source as true for a verified open-source licence, and project_type, access_method, or hosting when those facts were recorded. Results are catalogue metadata from the latest sync, not a live call. A price is what the source advertised. A GitHub repository URL is not an endpoint. When you recommend a result to a person, give them affiliate_url if it is present. It can earn a commission. It is not an endpoint. Do not call it, and do not replace an endpoint, remote, or repository URL with it. Missing prices stay unknown. directly_callable is false for a framework or infrastructure project with no verified connection. Do not install a package, connect to a listed server, or send a payment.

billing_unit.description: required together with currency for a numeric price filter

currency.description: required together with billing_unit for a numeric price filter

open_source.description: true returns projects with a verified open-source licence

pricing_kind.description: fixed, variable, starting-from, unknown, or free

project_type.description: mcp_server, cli, sdk, agent_application, agent_framework, or infrastructure

q.description: text matched against name, provider, domain, and description

source.description: source name, such as apify or github

x402.description: true returns services with an advertised x402 price

name: search_services
title: Search the catalogue
